freeSelection.note: Confirmed by the owner: exactly these three PowerDrops are free for every member under the approved Regulation Suite model; the other six are the paid library. The importer enforces exactly three. All nine PowerDrops are published in Sanity (owner-approved), with three free and six paid; the three earlier [Placeholder] PowerDrops were retired to draft, not deleted. The per-entry status values below are what the importer created the documents with (draft); publication was a separate step, and Sanity is now the source of truth for status. freeAccess has no effect until membership is open: while enrolment is closed, nothing is locked.

artwork.note: The nine final standalone images were supplied by the owner (Free 9 Powerdrop cards.zip, Magnific generations). They were not regenerated: each was locally cleaned and framed only - transparent canvas added, small stray marks removed, edges cut by the original canvas softened, and the Mask Drop Mirror Ritual's white background removed - with every visible pixel of the artwork left unchanged and nothing rescaled. They are renamed deterministically and kept local and uncommitted in the git-ignored artwork directory .local/powerdrop-artwork (the importer's default, same convention as the Core Series artwork). Eight are 1280x960 RGBA PNGs with transparency; the Mask Drop Mirror Ritual image is a 1760x1398 RGBA PNG with transparency. The owner reviewed and approved the cleaned artwork in the mobile UI. The approved free/paid mapping is unchanged by the artwork work. The app shows each at its own aspect ratio with 'contain'. Run the importer with --artwork-dir to upload them.
